items.title: Is Arthur J. Gallagher (AJG) Fully Priced After Strong Q3 Results?

Gallagher has delivered a 75.7% share price return over the past 5 years, which naturally raises the question of whether the business now earns enough on the capital it deploys to back up that kind of move. With fresh earnings news in the mix and the stock trading around US$268.20, the issue is how much of those returns on capital are already baked into today’s valuation.
